qe: Which village official keeps the account of the village rent collections?
qh: गाँव का कौन-सा अधिकारी गाँव में भू-भाटक (लगान) की वसूली का हिसाब रखता है?
e: Patna jile ke gaon me kai karmchari kaam karte the, jinme patwari sabse mahatvapurn tha. Uska mukhya kaam gaon me lagan yaani rent ki vasooli ka hisab rakhna tha. Ek vishesh baat yah thi ki asli raiyat ke bhes me ek karmchari hote the jo rajya ka naukar hota tha tatha lagan vasool karne wale ke upar nigrani rakhta tha; lekin Permanent Settlement ke baad wohi patwari zamindar ka naukar ban gaya. Iske badle uski haisiyat badal gayi - pehle woh sarkar ka nigranak tha, baad me woh zamindar ke hit ka dekhne wala ban gaya. Jab ek gaon me kai estate ban gaye, to aksar ek gaon me ek se zyada patwari ho jaate the tatha har patwari apni estate ka hisab rakhta tha. Exam point: patwari gaon me lagan vasooli ka hisab rakhta tha; pehle woh rajya ka naukar tatha vasoolkar par nigrani rakhne wala adhikari tha; Permanent Settlement ke baad woh zamindar ka naukar ban gaya tatha estate vibhajan ke kaaran ek gaon me kai patwari bhi ho sakte the.

qe: What change came about in the position of the patwari after the Permanent Settlement?
qh: पटवारी की स्थिति में स्थायी बंदोबस्त के बाद क्या परिवर्तन हुआ?
oe: He became an officer of the district court
He passed from being a servant of the state to a servant of the zamindar
He was replaced by the gumashta everywhere
He was made headman of the village
oh: वह जिला अदालत का अधिकारी बन गया
वह राज्य का कर्मचारी रहता हुआ ज़मींदार का कर्मचारी बन गया
उसे हर जगह गुमाश्ता ने बदल दिया
उसे गाँव का मुखिया बना दिया गया
e: Patna jile me patwari bahut purana gaon-adhikari tha. Us samay yah adhikari rajya ka naukar tha tatha lagan vasoolne wale par nigrani rakhta tha. Iske badle woh ek vishesh kaam karta tha. Iska mukhya uddeshya gaon ke raiyaton se jo lagan vasool hoti thi, uska poora hisab rakhna tha. Permanent Settlement ke baad haalat badal gayin. Ab woh rajya ka naukar nahi, balki zamindar ka naukar ban gaya. Patwaris aksar keval do rupaye mahine ka naami vetan paate the, lekin bade estates me unhe aath ya das rupaye bhi milte the; jahan vetan keval naam ka hota tha, wahan unhe produce-rent yaani anaj ke roop me milne wali vasooli par chhah-solah hisse seer per maund ke hisaab se bhatta milta tha. Exam point: Permanent Settlement se pehle patwari rajya ka naukar tha tatha grihasth ke maalik ki taraf se nahi, upar se kaam karta tha; bad me woh zamindar ka naukar ban gaya; uska vetan do se das rupaye mahina tak hota tha tatha anaj-vasooli par chhah-solah hisse seer per maund bhatta bhi milta tha.

qe: Which village official collects the rents and looks after the interest of his zamindar, often on a nominal pay with a share in abwabs and a commission?
qh: गाँव का कौन-सा अधिकारी लगान वसूल करता है तथा अपने ज़मींदार के हित की देखरेख करता है, जिसे अक्सर नाम-मात्र वेतन तथा अबवाब में हिस्सा एवं कमीशन मिलता है?
e: Gaon me lagan vasoolne tatha zamindar ke hit ki dekh-rekh karne wala adhikari gumashta kehlata tha. Uska vetan aksar naam-matra hota tha, isliye uski aay ka bada hissa abwab yaani lagan ke upar li jaane wali chhoti-chhoti vasooliyon me hisse tatha produce-rent par commission se chalta tha; jahan anaj ke roop me lagan milti thi, wahan uske hisse ka hisaab chhah-solah seer per maund ke hisaab se hota tha. Gumashta ke saath barahil log kaam karte the, jo uski madad se lagan vasoolte the tatha unka commission aksar chhah-solah hisse se kam hota tha. Aisi vyavastha dikhati hai ki us daur me gaon ka revenue-tantra vetan se zyada abwab tatha commission par chalta tha, jisse raiyaton par bhoj badh jaata tha. Exam point: lagan vasoolne wala adhikari gumashta tha tatha woh naam-matra vetan, abwab me hissa tatha anaj-lagan par chhah-solah hisse seer per maund commission paata tha; barahil uski madad karte the, jinka commission chhah-solah hisse se kam hota tha.

qe: Which village official was the watchman of the zamindar's village office, carried messages for the gumashta and escorted raiyats to the zamindar's presence?
qh: गाँव का कौन-सा अधिकारी ज़मींदार के गाँव-कार्यालय का चौकीदार था, गुमाश्ता के संदेश ले जाता था तथा रैयतों को ज़मींदार के सामने ले जाता था?
e: Gaon ke revenue-karmchariyon me gorait ka kaam suraksha tatha sandesh pahunchane se juda tha. Woh zamindar ke gaon-karyalay ka chaukidar tha, gumashta ke sandesh ek jagah se doosri jagah pahunchata tha tatha un raiyaton ko, jo zamindar ki rivaz ki maangon ko poora karne jaate the, izzat ke saath zamindar ke saamne pesh karta tha. Aisi maangon me ghee, doodh, bakri tatha aise hi anya saman shamil hote the, jinke daam rivaz ke hisaab se kam liye jaate the. Gorait kabhi-kabhi jaribkash yaani zameen naapne wale ka kaam bhi karta tha tatha aise jhagde me test yaani jaanch bhi karata tha. Is tarah yah adhikari zamindari vyavastha me aankh-kan ke roop me kaam karta tha. Exam point: gorait zamindar ke gaon-karyalay ka chaukidar tha, gumashta ke sandesh le jata tha tatha raiyaton ko zamindar ke saamne pesh karta tha; ghee, doodh tatha bakri jaisi maangein uske zariye pahunchti thin; woh jaribkash ka kaam bhi karta tha.

qe: The hatwa is a permanent institution in villages where a large proportion of the rent is paid in kind. What was his function?
qh: जिन गाँवों में लगान का बड़ा हिस्सा अनाज के रूप में दिया जाता था, वहाँ हटवा स्थायी संस्था था। उसका कार्य क्या था?
oe: To guard the village granary at night
To weigh the crops for division and make the test in disputed appraisements
To collect the rent in cash
oh: रात में गाँव के कोठार की रखवाली करना
बँटवारे के लिए फसल तोलना तथा विवादित अनुमानों में परीक्षण करना
e: Patna jile ke kai gaon me lagan ka bada hissa anaj yaani kind ke roop me diya jaata tha. Aise gaon me hatwa ek sthayi adhikari hota tha, isliye uski upasthiti zaruri maani jaati thi. Uska mukhya kaam katai ke baad faslon ko tolna tha, jisse zamindar tatha raiyat ke hisse theek-theek bant jayein; isi tarah jab kisi khet ya fasl ke anuman par jhagda hota, to uske test yaani jaanch ka kaam bhi hatwa hi karta tha. Yah kaam mahatvapurn tha, kyunki anaj ke roop me lagan lene se hisse-bantware ka jhagda aam baat thi tatha tolne wale ki neeyat par hi poora faisla nirbhar karta tha. Aise adhikari dikhate hain ki gaon ka revenue-tantra alag-alag kaam ke liye alag-alag karmchari rakhta tha. Exam point: hatwa yaani tulawan gaon me sthayi adhikari tha tatha uske hat me faslon ko tolne tatha jhagde ke samay parikshan karne ka kaam tha; yeh vyavastha un gaon me thi jahan lagan ka bada hissa anaj me diya jaata tha.

qe: Who is the jeth-raiyat or mahatwara of a village?
qh: गाँव का जेठ-रैयत या महतवारा कौन होता था?
oe: The principal cultivator of the village, appointed by the landlord
The oldest man of the village
oh: गाँव का प्रमुख कृषक, जिसे ज़मींदार नियुक्त करता था
e: Gaon ka jeth-raiyat ya mahatwara woh pramukh kisan hota tha, jise zamindar is samajh par niyukt karta tha ki woh apne prabhav se gaon ke raiyaton ko zamindar ke paksh me rakhega. Iske badle me uski kuch suvidhayen hoti thin - gaon ke sinchai ke kaam yaani aahar-pyne ki marammat ke samay woh zamindar se peshgi yaani advance leta tha tatha us kaam ki nigrani khud karta tha; agar gaon me koi gumashta nahi hota, to woh zamindar ki taraf se lagan bhi vasoolta tha, tatha in sewaon ke badle uska lagan thoda kam rakha jaata tha. Is tarah yah ek pul ka kaam karta tha, jo zamindar tatha raiyaton ke beech sampark banaye rakhta tha. Aise prabandh se pata chalta hai ki us daur me zamindari prashasan niji rishton tatha prabhav par tika tha. Exam point: jeth-raiyat ya mahatwara gaon ka pramukh kisan hota tha, jise zamindar niyukt karta tha; woh sinchai ke kaam me peshgi lekar nigrani karta tha, zarurat padne par lagan bhi vasoolta tha tatha badle me thoda kam lagan deta tha.

qe: In the Patna district the amin was specially appointed by the zamindar for which work?
qh: पटना जिले में अमीन को ज़मींदार द्वारा विशेष रूप से किस काम के लिए नियुक्त किया जाता था?
oh: अनाज के रूप में लगान तोलना
e: Patna jile ke gaon me amin ek aisa adhikari tha, jise zamindar vishesh roop se anuman lene tatha uske samay par hue jhagde ke liye niyukt karta tha. Anuman ka matlab tha yah andaza lagana ki kisi khet me kitni fasal hui hai tatha uske hisaab se lagan ka hissa kitna banega. Ek hi amin zaruri nahi tha ki poore gaon ke anumanon me shamil ho; bade estates me amin aksar zamindar ke mukhyalay ke staff ka hissa hota tha, tatha jahan anuman ho raha tha, wahan gaon ka rahne wala nahi hota tha - isse yah bharosa rakhna tha ki woh sthanik prabhav se prabhavit nahi hoga. Gaon ke aise lagbhag sabhi revenue-karmchari, hatwa ko chhod kar, zamindar ke naukar the, gaon ke nahi. Exam point: amin ko zamindar anuman yaani appraisement ke liye niyukt karta tha; bade estates me woh zamindar ke mukhyalay ka staff hota tha tatha anuman wale gaon ka nivasi nahi hota tha; gaon ke adhiktar revenue-karmchari zamindar ke naukar the.

qe: Apart from the revenue officials, whose wife acts as the midwife of the village in the Patna district?
qh: पटना जिले में राजस्व-अधिकारियों के अतिरिक्त गाँव की दाई का काम किसकी पत्नी करती थी?
e: Patna jile ke gaon me revenue ke adhikariyon ke alava aise kai karmchari the jo gaon ki rozana zaruraton ke liye zaruri the. Inme nai yaani hajjam aata tha, jo shadi tatha mrityu jaisi rasmon me mahatvapurn kaam karta tha; badhai tatha lohar kheti ke auzaar banane tatha unki marammat ke liye zaruri the; dhobi kapde dhota tha; tatha chamar ki patni gaon me dai yaani midwife ka kaam karti thi. Is tarah gaon ek aisi chhoti vyavastha thi jisme kai peshe apne-apne kaam se jude the tatha lagbhag sabhi aavashyaktaon ki poori gaon me hi ho jaati thi. Aise varnan se gaon ki aatm-nirbhar arthavyavastha tatha jati-peshe ke rishte ka pata chalta hai. Exam point: gaon me dai ka kaam chamar ki patni karti thi; nai shadi tatha mrityu ki rasmon me mahatvapurn bhumika nibhata tha; badhai tatha lohar kheti ke auzaar banane ke liye tatha dhobi kapde dhone ke liye zaruri the.
